read_dduf_file: read a DDUF file and return a dictionary of file entries with offsets and lengths without loading data into memory
export_folder_as_dduf: export a folder containing a diffusion model as an uncompressed DDUF archive file
export_entries_as_dduf: export an iterable of filename-content pairs into an uncompressed DDUF archive file
DDUFEntry_as_mmap: open a DDUF file entry as a memory-mapped file for loading safetensors directly from the archive
DDUFEntry_read_text: read a DDUF file entry as text for JSON or TXT entries using UTF-8 encoding
